title: P0.85: Startup Chat-First Bridge Readiness
description: Make the human communication channel available before heavy metacognitive startup refresh blocks lazy VM prebuild.
reason: Live Windows audit on 2026-06-01 showed page_loader_ready in ~2s but UIBridge/chat did not become reachable until much later because ControlCenterVM prebuild paused behind startup_truth_refresh. The user could see the app before the app could reliably communicate back.
next_action: Restart from the desktop shortcut and verify human_simulated_chat_audit passes within 30 seconds after the UI is visible.
resume_hint: ControlCenterVM now bypasses truth_refresh/startup_evolution prebuild pauses once deferred setup is complete; non-control VMs still pause under background work/resource pressure.
